author: Twillion
name: CameraTweens3D
shortDescription: Procedural camera motion: head bobbing, run/walk leaning, critically damped weapon recoil, jump landing shocks, trauma shakes (T^2), dynamic FOV, and anti-nausea comfort mode.
description:
**CameraTweens3D** is a modular, high-polish procedural camera modifier and tweening extension for **GDevelop 5 (Three.js backend)**.

Instead of replacing your existing camera, **CameraTweens3D** acts as a plug-and-play procedural effect layer that sits on top of **any** 3D camera (GDevelop's built-in First Person 3D camera, Third-Person camera, top-down view, or vehicle rigs)—instantly giving your game AAA-grade physical weight, dynamic head bobbing, run/walk leaning, jump landing shocks, trauma-based screen shakes, weapon recoil kicks, and smooth FOV transitions.

### Key Highlights:
- **Universal Camera Compatibility:** Works seamlessly with GDevelop's built-in First Person camera, Third Person camera, custom rigs, and vehicle cameras without control conflicts.
- **8 Modular Tuning Categories:** Granular control over Head Bobbing, Run/Walk Leaning, Jump Landing Shocks, Breathing Sway, Weapon Recoil, Explosion Trauma ($T^2$), Dynamic FOV, and Master Accessibility Scales.
- **4 One-Click Genre Presets:** Instantly apply pre-configured camera profiles (`ImmersiveHorror`, `FastArcadeShooter`, `TacticalMilitary`, `AccessibilityComfort`).
- **Full In-Game Options Menu Support:** Global multiplier actions allow hooking player settings sliders directly into camera shake and motion scales.
- **Motion Sickness / Anti-Nausea Mode:** Instantly zero out roll tilt, horizontal sway, and harsh FOV changes with a single action.

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: CameraTweens3D
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Modular procedural camera modifier for GDevelop 3D. Adds dual-octave Lissajous head bobbing, run/walk leaning, jump landing shocks, critically damped weapon recoil, non-linear trauma shakes (T^2), dynamic FOV transitions, and anti-nausea comfort mode.

propertyDescriptors.name: PresetProfile
propertyDescriptors.label: Genre Preset Profile
propertyDescriptors.description: 1-Click camera feel profile for your game genre.

propertyDescriptors.name: BobProfile
propertyDescriptors.label: Head Bob Style
propertyDescriptors.description: Walking and sprinting head bobbing motion style.

propertyDescriptors.name: LeanProfile
propertyDescriptors.label: Run/Walk Lean Intensity
propertyDescriptors.description: How far the camera leans while moving: roll when running or walking sideways, plus banking into turns. "Off" disables both.

propertyDescriptors.name: LandingImpactProfile
propertyDescriptors.label: Landing Impact Feel
propertyDescriptors.description: Vertical compression and pitch dip when hitting the ground, scaled by how fast you fell.

propertyDescriptors.name: RecoilProfile
propertyDescriptors.label: Weapon Recoil Feel
propertyDescriptors.description: Upward weapon kickback and spring snap return. "Off" also disables recoil yaw and kickback.

propertyDescriptors.name: ShakeProfile
propertyDescriptors.label: Explosion Shake Power
propertyDescriptors.description: Trauma screen shake magnitude for explosions and hits.

propertyDescriptors.name: BaseFOV
propertyDescriptors.label: Base Field of View (°, 0 = keep layer FOV)
propertyDescriptors.description: Baseline resting Field of View in degrees. Leave at 0 to inherit whatever the 3D layer is already set to, so adding this behavior does not change how your game looks.

propertyDescriptors.name: ADSFOVTarget
propertyDescriptors.label: ADS Zoom FOV (°, 0 = auto)
propertyDescriptors.description: Zoomed-in Field of View when aiming down sights. Leave at 0 for two thirds of the base FOV.

propertyDescriptors.name: MasterMotionScale
propertyDescriptors.label: Master Motion Scale
propertyDescriptors.description: Global multiplier for all motions (0.0 = disabled, 1.0 = normal). Wire this to a player settings slider.

propertyDescriptors.name: MasterShakeScale
propertyDescriptors.label: Master Shake Scale
propertyDescriptors.description: Global multiplier for all trauma and explosion shakes. Wire this to a player settings slider.

propertyDescriptors.name: MotionSicknessMode
propertyDescriptors.label: Motion Sickness / Comfort Mode
propertyDescriptors.description: Holds the horizon flat: no run/walk lean, no turn lean, no horizontal sway, and the sprint FOV stays locked. "Auto" follows the operating system’s reduced-motion setting.

propertyDescriptors.name: WorldUnitsPerMeter
propertyDescriptors.label: World Units per Meter (0 = auto)
propertyDescriptors.description: How many scene units make one meter. GDevelop 3D uses the same units as 2D, so 100 suits most projects. Leave at 0 to estimate it from the object height.

propertyDescriptors.name: WalkSpeedReference
propertyDescriptors.label: Walk Speed Reference (0 = auto)
propertyDescriptors.description: The movement speed, in world units per second, that counts as a full-amplitude walk. Leave at 0 to read it from the character behavior.

propertyDescriptors.name: TerrainMicroJitterIntensity
propertyDescriptors.label: Terrain Micro-Jitter (metres, 0 = off)
propertyDescriptors.description: Noisy vertical camera motion while grounded and moving. Set to 0 for a stable camera; 0.015 matches the original effect.

propertyDescriptors.name: Layer
propertyDescriptors.label: Target 3D Layer
propertyDescriptors.description: Name of the 3D layer containing the camera (leave empty for Base layer).

eventsFunctions.name: ApplyPreset
eventsFunctions.sentence: Apply camera preset _PARAM2_ on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Applies a built-in genre tuning profile (Tactical Military, Immersive Horror, Fast Arcade Shooter, Accessibility & Comfort).

parameters.name: Preset
parameters.supplementaryInformation: ["Tactical Military (COD / Tarkov)","Immersive Horror (Outlast / RE7)","Fast Arcade Shooter (DOOM / Quake)","Accessibility & Comfort (Zero Motion Sickness)","Custom"]

eventsFunctions.name: SetBobProfile
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set head bob style on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Sets the head bob style (Off, Subtle, Standard, Heavy, Intense).

eventsFunctions.name: SetLeanProfile
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set run/walk lean intensity on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: How far the camera leans while moving: roll when running or walking sideways, plus banking into turns. "Off" disables both.

eventsFunctions.name: SetLandingImpactProfile
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set landing impact style on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Sets landing shock compression profile (Off, Soft, Standard, Heavy, Deep Impact).

eventsFunctions.name: SetBreathingProfile
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set breathing style on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Sets idle breathing sway profile (Off, Subtle, Standard, Deep Breathing).

eventsFunctions.name: SetRecoilProfile
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set recoil feel on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Sets weapon recoil feel (Off, Subtle Kick, Standard FPS, Heavy Kick, Crisp Boomer Shooter).

parameters.name: Profile
parameters.supplementaryInformation: ["Default for Preset","Off (Disabled)","Subtle Kick","Standard FPS","Heavy Kick","Crisp Boomer Shooter"]

eventsFunctions.name: SetShakeProfile
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set shake power on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Sets trauma shake power (Off, Soft, Standard, Cinematic Heavy).

eventsFunctions.name: SetSpeedRushFOVProfile
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set speed rush FOV boost on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Sets sprinting FOV rush profile (Off, Subtle, Standard, Extreme).

eventsFunctions.name: SetMasterMotionScale
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set master motion scale on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Multiplies all procedural motions (bob, breathing, tilt) by a global scale (0.0 = disabled).

eventsFunctions.name: SetMasterShakeScale
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set master shake scale on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Multiplies all trauma and explosion camera shakes by a global scale.

eventsFunctions.name: SetMotionSicknessMode
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set motion sickness mode on _PARAM0_: _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Enables or disables anti-nausea comfort mode (holds the horizon flat and stops horizontal sway).

eventsFunctions.name: AddTrauma
eventsFunctions.sentence: Add trauma to _PARAM0_ by _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Adds shake trauma from an explosion, impact, or hit (0.0 to 1.0). Trauma decays smoothly over time.

eventsFunctions.name: ApplyRecoil
eventsFunctions.sentence: Apply weapon recoil to _PARAM0_ (Pitch: _PARAM2_, Yaw: _PARAM3_, KickbackZ: _PARAM4_)
eventsFunctions.description: Fires a high-stiffness spring recoil impulse that kicks the camera up, applies random spread, and shoves backward along view axis.

parameters.name: KickbackZ
parameters.description: Backward kickback displacement in world units

eventsFunctions.name: ApplyDamageFlinch
eventsFunctions.sentence: Apply damage flinch to _PARAM0_ (Angle: _PARAM2_, Force: _PARAM3_)
eventsFunctions.description: Applies a directional flinch jerk away from incoming bullet or melee damage.

parameters.name: Angle
parameters.description: Direction angle of incoming damage in degrees

eventsFunctions.name: TriggerLandingImpact
eventsFunctions.sentence: Trigger landing impact on _PARAM0_ with fall speed _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Forces a vertical compression dip and forward pitch jerk as if landing from a fall. The depth scales with the fall speed you pass in.

parameters.name: FallSpeed
parameters.description: Downward speed in world units per second

eventsFunctions.name: StopAllShakes
eventsFunctions.sentence: Stop all camera shakes on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Instantly resets trauma to 0.0, halting all explosion shakes.

eventsFunctions.name: SetADS
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set Aim Down Sights (ADS) on _PARAM0_: _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Smoothly transitions camera FOV and damping into or out of weapon aiming mode.

eventsFunctions.name: SetSprinting
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set sprinting state on _PARAM0_: _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Transitions into or out of sprint speed rush FOV and stride frequency boost.

eventsFunctions.name: SetCrouching
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set crouching state on _PARAM0_: _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Applies sneaking/crouch damping to reduce head bobbing amplitude.

eventsFunctions.name: TweenFOV
eventsFunctions.sentence: Tween camera FOV on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_ over _PARAM3_ seconds
eventsFunctions.description: Smoothly transitions the camera Field of View to a target degree, then holds it. The resting FOV is not overwritten — use "Release FOV tween" to hand control back to base / ADS / sprint.

parameters.name: TargetFOV
parameters.description: Target Field of View in degrees

eventsFunctions.name: ReleaseFOVTween
eventsFunctions.sentence: Release FOV tween on _PARAM0_ over _PARAM2_ seconds
eventsFunctions.description: Eases the Field of View back from a held tween to the automatic value (base, ADS or sprint) and hands control back.

eventsFunctions.name: SetADSFOVTarget
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set ADS zoom FOV on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_ degrees
eventsFunctions.description: Adjusts the zoomed-in Field of View used while aiming down sights (e.g. per weapon scope).

parameters.name: FOV
parameters.description: ADS Field of View in degrees

eventsFunctions.name: SetManualLeanAngle
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set manual lean angle on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_ degrees
eventsFunctions.description: Sets corner peeking roll tilt angle (e.g. -12.0 for left Q peek, +12.0 for right E peek, 0.0 to return to center).

eventsFunctions.name: SetBaseFOV
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set base resting FOV on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_ degrees
eventsFunctions.description: Adjusts resting Field of View (e.g. from user FOV slider settings).

parameters.name: FOV
parameters.description: Base Field of View in degrees

eventsFunctions.name: SetBobIntensity
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set head bob intensity on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Dynamically adjusts walking and running head bob amplitude multiplier.

eventsFunctions.name: SetBreathingIntensity
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set breathing intensity on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Dynamically adjusts idle breathing sway amplitude multiplier.

eventsFunctions.name: SetTerrainMicroJitterIntensity
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set terrain micro-jitter intensity on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_ metres
eventsFunctions.description: Sets the noisy vertical motion added while grounded and moving. Use 0 to disable it.

parameters.name: Intensity
parameters.description: Vertical jitter amplitude in metres (0 disables)

eventsFunctions.name: SetTargetLayer
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set target 3D layer for _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Sets the 3D layer name that contains the camera to modify (empty for base layer).

eventsFunctions.name: SetLeanMaxAngle
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set run/walk lean max angle on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_ degrees
eventsFunctions.description: The furthest the camera leans when moving at full speed sideways. Use a negative value if the lean tilts the wrong way for your rig.

parameters.name: Angle
parameters.description: Max lean angle in degrees (negative inverts)

eventsFunctions.name: SetTurnLeanAngle
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set turn lean angle on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_ degrees
eventsFunctions.description: How far the camera banks into a turn, on top of the run/walk lean. Use a negative value to invert the direction.

parameters.name: Angle
parameters.description: Turn lean angle in degrees (negative inverts)

eventsFunctions.name: SetADSMotionDamping
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set ADS motion damping on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: How much all procedural motion is scaled down while aiming down sights (0.0 = perfectly still, 1.0 = no damping).

eventsFunctions.name: SetManualLeanMaxAngle
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set manual lean max angle on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_ degrees
eventsFunctions.description: Sets the limit that "Set manual lean angle" is clamped to, and the angle at which the full sideways eye offset is reached.

eventsFunctions.name: SetWorldUnitsPerMeter
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set world units per meter on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Sets the scale used to convert the internal physical model into your scene. 100 suits a default GDevelop 3D project; 0 auto-detects from the object height.

parameters.name: Units
parameters.description: World units in one meter (0 = auto)

eventsFunctions.name: SetLandingShockIntensity
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set landing shock intensity on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Dynamically adjusts vertical landing impact compression multiplier.

eventsFunctions.name: SetRecoilPitchMultiplier
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set recoil pitch multiplier on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_
eventsFunctions.description: Dynamically scales weapon upward kick (e.g. reduced when attaching a weapon grip or compensator).

eventsFunctions.name: SetTraumaDecayRate
eventsFunctions.sentence: Set trauma decay rate on _PARAM0_ to _PARAM2_ per second
eventsFunctions.description: Adjusts how fast explosion and impact camera shake fades per second.

eventsFunctions.name: IsADS
eventsFunctions.sentence: _PARAM0_ is Aiming Down Sights (ADS)
eventsFunctions.description: Checks if the camera is currently in ADS aiming mode.

eventsFunctions.name: IsSprinting
eventsFunctions.sentence: _PARAM0_ is in sprinting rush FOV
eventsFunctions.description: Checks if sprint rush FOV and stride boost are active.

eventsFunctions.name: IsCrouching
eventsFunctions.sentence: _PARAM0_ is crouching
eventsFunctions.description: Checks if sneak/crouch damping is currently active.

eventsFunctions.name: IsTraumaShakeActive
eventsFunctions.sentence: Trauma shake is active on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns true if explosion shake trauma is greater than 0.01.

eventsFunctions.name: IsRecoilActive
eventsFunctions.sentence: Weapon recoil spring is active on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns true if weapon recoil spring is currently in motion.

eventsFunctions.name: IsMotionSicknessMode
eventsFunctions.sentence: Motion sickness comfort mode is active on _PARAM0_
eventsFunctions.description: Returns true if anti-nausea comfort mode is enabled.

eventsFunctions.name: IsGrounded
eventsFunctions.sentence: _PARAM0_ is detected as being on the ground
eventsFunctions.description: Returns true if the ground state the camera is using reports the object as standing on the floor. Useful for checking that the character behavior was detected at all.

eventsFunctions.name: RollOffset
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the live procedural roll delta applied to the camera in degrees.

eventsFunctions.name: HeadBobY
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the vertical head bob offset actually applied to the camera this frame, in world units.

eventsFunctions.name: HeadBobX
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the horizontal head sway offset actually applied to the camera this frame, in world units.

eventsFunctions.name: LandingDipY
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the vertical landing compression offset applied this frame, in world units.

eventsFunctions.name: RecoilPitch
eventsFunctions.description: Returns current weapon recoil pitch displacement in degrees.

eventsFunctions.name: RecoilYaw
eventsFunctions.description: Returns current weapon recoil yaw displacement in degrees.

eventsFunctions.name: RecoilKickbackZ
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the weapon recoil backward translation applied this frame, in world units.

eventsFunctions.name: WorldUnitsPerMeter
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the scale in use for converting the internal physical model into scene units.

eventsFunctions.name: CurrentFOV
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the actual live interpolated Field of View in degrees.

eventsFunctions.name: TraumaLevel
eventsFunctions.description: Returns current trauma level (0.0 to 1.0).

eventsFunctions.name: MovementSpeedRatio
eventsFunctions.description: Returns current normalized movement speed ratio driving stride frequency.

eventsFunctions.name: MasterMotionScale
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the master motion scale multiplier.

eventsFunctions.name: MasterShakeScale
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the master shake scale multiplier.

eventsFunctions.name: BobIntensity
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the current head bob intensity multiplier.

eventsFunctions.name: BreathingIntensity
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the current idle breathing sway intensity multiplier.

eventsFunctions.name: BaseFOV
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the baseline resting Field of View in degrees.

eventsFunctions.name: ManualLeanAngle
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the current corner peeking manual lean angle in degrees.

eventsFunctions.name: TerrainMicroJitterIntensity
eventsFunctions.description: Returns the configured terrain micro-jitter amplitude in metres.
